Name: Hardy Grass
Author: DiscipleOfEris
Description:
Cutting grass or animals eating it no longer completely destroys a patch! Instead, short grass is left behind, giving it a chance to regrow. As an added bonus, this cut grass will no longer slow you down when walking through it.
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
Settings can be configured easily with the optional Generic Mod Config Menu mod.

Furthermore, a new grass starter recipe is available, the Quick Grass Starter, for faster-growing and -spreading grass, though both grass starters now start off short and need a day or two to grow useful grass. The new recipe for Quick Grass Starter can be purchased from Pierre.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[*]This mod makes fairly extensive use of Harmony patching, so it may be incompatible with other grass mods, other mods that affect animal eating habits, or perhaps mods for no obvious reason. If you find a mod incompatibility, please inform me.
[*]Incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48334523]Satozaki[/url]﻿.
[*]The "Collect Hay With Full or No Silos" feature from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1430]Better Hay[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342]CatCattyCat[/url]﻿ won't work with this mod.﻿
[/list]
